sav.qa_enrich_no_power_270: Connected to the charger with the battery, does the device power on and show the charging symbol?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_588: On the power supply, does the device boot normally when pressing power?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_589: Does the current change when pressing the memory IC during boot?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_590: After boot, does the current drop back to idle level?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_594: During boot, does the screen light up and then the network appear (to pinpoint the failure stage)?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_653: Does the device boot on the power supply without the battery?
sav.qa_enrich_no_power_655: Is there current drawn before pressing power (VBAT/VPH leak)?
sav.qa_enrich_not_charging_336: Does a high-temperature message or indicator appear while charging?
sav.qa_enrich_not_charging_599: In diode mode, do the charge-port lines give a reading plus a beep to ground?
sav.qa_enrich_not_charging_622: With the charger powered, is voltage present across the charge port?
sav.qa_enrich_power_button_415: Are all buttons dead (common convergence point to check)?
sav.qa_enrich_power_button_600: In continuity (beep) mode, does the power button close when pressed?
sav.qa_enrich_black_screen_58: In the Samsung test (code *#0*#), does the Hall IC entry change state near a magnet?
sav.qa_enrich_mic_speaker_315: Did a mic/network/charge failure appear after a screen replacement?
sav.qa_enrich_mic_speaker_599: On multimeter test (beep/diode), do the buzzer, speaker and mic respond normally?
sav.qa_enrich_mic_speaker_596: Is the audio failure accompanied by network loss (suspect audio IC)?
sav.qa_enrich_no_network_368: Are all SIM lines present at the multimeter (VCC, RST, CLK, IO, ground)?
sav.qa_enrich_no_network_591a: After manual search, does only a single network show (suspect antenna switch)?
sav.qa_enrich_no_network_591b: Does the full network disappear a few seconds after boot (suspect PF)?
sav.qa_enrich_no_network_592: Is the IMEI present (*#06#) and does the manual search succeed?
sav.qa_enrich_no_network_596: Do the dropouts happen during transmission (outgoing calls, suspect RF power detector)?
sav.qa_enrich_touch_dead_413: Are the touch bus signals (I2C SDA/CLK or SPI) present between CPU and controller?

ia.advice_screen:
Screen issue detected.
1. Check physical condition (cracks, dead pixels)
2. Test with a replacement screen
3. Estimated part cost: 2000-8000 DA depending on model
4. Repair time: 30-60 min
ia.advice_battery:
Battery/charging issue detected.
1. Test with original charger
2. Check charging port
3. If not charging → replace battery (1500-4000 DA)
4. If slow charging → clean USB port (500-1000 DA)
ia.advice_audio:
Audio issue detected.
1. Check software settings
2. Test in safe mode
3. Clean speaker grille
4. Replace speaker: 800-2500 DA
5. Check motherboard if persists
ia.advice_water:
Water damage detected. URGENT!
1. DO NOT POWER ON
2. Disassemble and clean with isopropyl alcohol
3. Ultrasonic bath if available
4. Check corrosion on connectors
5. Replace corroded parts
6. Cost: 2000-15000 DA depending on severity
ia.advice_camera:
Camera issue detected.
1. Test with another app
2. Check for physical obstruction
3. Replace camera module: 1000-5000 DA
4. Time: 20-40 min
ia.advice_mic:
Microphone issue detected.
1. Test during call and voice recording
2. Clean microphone port
3. Replace microphone: 500-2000 DA
4. Check ribbon connector
ia.advice_connectivity:
Connectivity issue detected.
1. Reset network settings
2. Check if module is detected
3. WiFi/BT module repair: 1500-5000 DA
4. Test after factory reset
ia.advice_generic:
Non-specific fault detected.
1. Start with a complete visual inspection
2. Ask the client about circumstances
3. Check common points (power, connectors)
4. Proceed by elimination
5. Consult internal knowledge base
